questions.stem: Which statement best describes a data strategy?
options: The hands-on execution of ETL jobs and database deployments
The overarching plan and vision an organisation establishes to manage, govern and leverage its data assets
A short-term schedule for migrating data between servers
A catalogue of every table and column in the data warehouse
A set of business intelligence dashboards built for executives
questions.explanation: Data strategy is the high-level, long-term approach that aligns data initiatives with business objectives; it sets vision and direction rather than carrying out technical deployment.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a key component of data implementation rather than data strategy?
options: Vision and objectives
Governance framework
Technology roadmap
ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)
Data quality standards
questions.explanation: ETL processes for moving data from source systems to target databases belong to the practical, technical work of data implementation. The other four are components of a data strategy.

questions.stem: In the comparison of data strategy with data implementation, how do their timeframes differ?
options: Both are long-term activities concerned with sustained value
Data strategy is long-term, while data implementation involves short to medium-term activities
Data strategy is short-term, while data implementation spans decades
Neither has a defined timeframe
Both are limited to a single project cycle
questions.explanation: Data strategy generally has a long-term perspective focused on sustained value, whereas data implementation involves short to medium-term activities geared to the immediate deployment of data solutions.

questions.stem: Which key component of a data strategy defines how data is created, stored, used and retired over time?
options: Data lifecycle management
Data warehousing
Business intelligence
Database design and management
Data integration
questions.explanation: Data lifecycle management is the strategy component that defines how data moves from creation through storage and use to retirement.

questions.stem: A team is deploying a data warehouse for centralised storage and building BI dashboards to visualise the results. Which activity does this represent?
options: Defining a technology roadmap
Setting data quality standards
Data implementation
Establishing a governance framework
Articulating the data vision and objectives
questions.explanation: Implementing data warehouses and business intelligence tools is hands-on, tactical work, which is the domain of data implementation rather than strategy.

questions.stem: Which of these is NOT listed as a key component of data implementation?
options: Data security and compliance
Data integration
Business intelligence
Data warehousing
Vision and objectives
questions.explanation: Vision and objectives is a key component of data strategy. Data security and compliance, data integration, BI and data warehousing are all components of data implementation.

questions.stem: How do data strategy and data implementation differ in their level of detail?
options: Both are equally detailed and specific
Data strategy is detailed and specific, while data implementation is abstract
Data strategy is abstract and high-level, while data implementation is detailed and specific
Neither addresses detail; that is left to project management
Data implementation defines principles, while data strategy designs systems
questions.explanation: Data strategy defines principles, standards and overall guidelines at a high level; data implementation involves the actual design, deployment and operation of data systems in detail.

questions.stem: What does the data strategy component 'technology roadmap' outline?
options: The step-by-step configuration of each database server
The technologies and infrastructure needed to support data initiatives
The security patches applied to data systems each quarter
The visualisation templates used in BI reports
The schedule for retiring individual data records
questions.explanation: Within a data strategy, the technology roadmap outlines the technologies and infrastructure required to support the organisation's data initiatives.

questions.stem: Which pairing correctly matches focus to discipline?
options: Data strategy focuses on system deployment; data implementation focuses on business objectives
Data strategy focuses on business objectives, governance and strategic use of data; data implementation focuses on technical aspects and system deployment
Both focus exclusively on technical aspects
Data strategy focuses on ETL; data implementation focuses on vision
Both focus exclusively on governance policy
questions.explanation: Data strategy is concerned with business objectives, governance and using data as a valuable asset; data implementation is concerned with technical aspects, system deployment and hands-on management of data technologies.

questions.stem: A company writes policies and procedures for managing and securing its data and sets guidelines for the accuracy, completeness and reliability of that data. Which two data strategy components are being addressed?
options: Governance framework and data quality standards
Database design and ETL
Data warehousing and BI
Data integration and data security
Technology roadmap and data lifecycle management
questions.explanation: The governance framework establishes policies and procedures for managing and securing data, while data quality standards set guidelines for accuracy, completeness and reliability.
